entries.evaluator_question: Was the full 5,000-customer population actually executed?
entries.gap: Surface existing exact coverage in product evidence without UI recalculation.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Synthetic full-population execution is not real-bank validation.

entries.evaluator_question: Is the product more than a single-customer demo?
entries.gap: Post-P0 multi-customer review and representative-versus-operational-queue proof is still needed.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: A representative comparison is neither manual cherry-picking nor an operational selection.

entries.evaluator_question: Can the app itself show the 5k-to-RM story?
entries.gap: Feedback-oriented Portfolio and Queue evidence needs targeted verification; recording is a separate presentation task.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Video production is not an implemented product feature.

entries.evaluator_question: Is the unbounded selection treated as actual RM workload?
entries.gap: Human-supplied capacity comparison and approval provenance are not yet evidenced.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: 1,522 is not recommended, approved, daily, or optimal capacity.

entries.evaluator_question: Does Banker Workflow exist beyond analytics insight?
entries.gap: No persisted full selected-to-Alert/Audit runtime artifact or real RM operational usage exists.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: No production workflow integration, DB, or automated financial decision exists.

entries.evaluator_question: Is an RM informed at the right time?
entries.gap: There is no external delivery provider or real delivery/SLA evidence; timing and historical landmark copy need review.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim external delivery or a customer-specific future breakpoint date.

entries.evaluator_question: Does the RM know what to do next?
entries.gap: Human usability and action clarity need targeted evidence.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Recommendations are not automatic financial decisions or efficacy evidence.

entries.evaluator_question: Is Why Now distinct from the historical breakpoint?
entries.gap: Per-customer wording, empty states, and visual hierarchy require a focused review.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: A historical landmark is not a forecasted risk date for the current customer.

entries.evaluator_question: Is the prototype reproducible and engineering-ready?
entries.gap: Pre-commit artifact code references, stale current-state documentation, and Python 3.10.9 versus 3.11 target remain.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Do not call provenance and documentation fully release-clean.

entries.gap: Existing synthetic controls need continued regression protection.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Synthetic negative controls are not real-world accuracy, causal effect, or real-data validation.

entries.evaluator_question: Has real anonymized customer data been validated?
entries.gap: No approved anonymized data, adapter run, or real-data metric report exists.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Public, aggregate, or synthetic evidence cannot substitute for approved real-data validation.

entries.evaluator_question: Has a small RM pilot demonstrated usefulness, timeliness, workload, or follow-up?
entries.gap: No pilot protocol result or real participant data exists.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim RM acceptance, productivity, customer outcome, or intervention impact.

entries.evaluator_question: Are claims, documentation, and public-repository boundaries aligned?
entries.gap: Current-state statements and public artifact provenance require a final claims/security synchronization.
entries.forbidden_overclaim: Do not state real validation, external notification, or approved operational policy as completed.

out_of_scope_presentation_production: Video recording and slide production are not implementation-complete evidence.
The product must support the 5k-to-queue-to-customer-to-action flow before it is recorded.
